_README: Where every block animation attribute lives in an agent recipe (includes/recipe.php). tests/unit/recipe-coverage.test.js fails if an attribute registered in src/index.js isn't accounted for here, and tests/recipe/check.php checks every recipe path below exists in the recipe schema. Adding an attribute? Map it here AND handle it in both motion_blocks_recipe_to_attributes() and motion_blocks_attributes_to_recipe(), add a tests/schema-defaults/cases.php case that uses it (the round trip in tests/recipe/check.php then proves it), and regenerate the schema and reference: wp eval-file tests/recipe/check.php schema. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
_README_effectFields: Per-effect attributes. Each applies to the shared keys (animation{Suffix}, recipe `effect`) and to both Scroll Appear slots (animationEntry{Suffix} / animationExit{Suffix}, recipe `entry` / `exit`), except where `slotsOnly` says so.
_README_customProperties: Custom From / To values: animation[Entry|Exit](From|To){Prop} for every key of propertyDefaultUnits in shared-constants.json maps to `from.{prop}` / `to.{prop}` of the effect. Nothing to list here.

notInRecipes.animationPlayOnce: Legacy (pre-slot) Scroll Appear flag. Read through the migration shim; never written.
notInRecipes.animationScrollTrigger: Legacy (pre-slot) Scroll Appear trigger. Read through the migration shim; never written.
notInRecipes.animationPreviewEnabled: Editor preview state (kept in the editor-preview store, not saved).
